milano-high-illuminated-planters: MILANO HIGH planters have built-in lighting, so your plants keep glowing long after the sun has set.
tokyo-illuminated-round-planters: An illuminated planter like the TOKYO makes one plant do the work of a floor lamp — light and greenery in a single object.
venice-planter: Tall planters like VENICE suit deep-rooted plants — palms and hibiscus grow surprisingly long roots.
paris-planters: PARIS-style tapered planters are wider at the top, giving room to the feeder roots where plants do most of their drinking.
window-planter: Window planters have dressed streets for centuries — towns in Alsace, France, are famous for geraniums spilling from every sill.
snorlax-round-planter: Round planters have no weak corners, so soil dries evenly and roots circle naturally — good design, not just good looks.
ringstone-ring-planter: A ring planter turns one plant into a centrepiece — perfect for framing an entryway or a lobby pillar.
ceira-planter: Modern planters like CEIRA are usually double-walled, which insulates roots from summer heat and winter chills alike.
globus-planter: The globe is nature's favourite shape — spheres hold the most volume using the least material.
grower-planter-28: The '28' is the size code — and a bigger planter doesn't just fit a bigger plant, it needs watering less often.
bello-hanging-planter: Hanging planters put your floor to better use and keep trailing plants safely away from pets and toddlers.
valencia-planters: VALENCIA planters are UV-stabilised, so they don't fade or turn brittle under Indore's fierce summer sun.
valencia-with-wheels-planters-kit: On lockable wheels, even a waterlogged 40-kg planter glides across the terrace — no dragging, no scratched tiles.
tunis-indoor-outdoor-planter: Indoor-outdoor planters like TUNIS are made to shrug off sun, monsoon rain and air-conditioned rooms alike.
rome-eco-planter: ECO planters are moulded from recycled plastic — your plant lives in yesterday's containers, reborn.
